html:
The Klahoose are a Coast Salish people of Desolation Sound and Toba Inlet, on the mainland coast of British Columbia north of Vancouver. They are one of the three groups of the Tla'amin or Mainland Comox, with the Homalco and Tla'amin, and speak the Comox language.

Their oral tradition says they descend from the survivors of a great flood. They lived from salmon, shellfish and cedar in the deep fjords of the coast. Canada later split the three groups into separate band councils. Today the Klahoose live mainly at Squirrel Cove on Cortes Island.
